The '''Janako system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Janako]], a model of the [[MaKing-class transport|''MaKing''-class transport]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|137|Janako}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Janako [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-11.<ref name="TEA" />
